guide.title: Short Upper Mustang Trek | Explore
guide.description:
Short Upper Mustang Trek Explore Mustang in 7-10 Days
Embark on an unforgettable journey through the mystical landscapes of Upper
Mustang with our Short Upper Mustang Trek. Designed for adventure seekers with
limited time, this 7-10 day trek o ff ers a perfect blend of Nepal’s cultural heritage,
ancient Tibetan villages, and stunning desert-like scenery. Explore hidden caves,
monasteries, and the unique Mustang architecture while trekking through Lo
Manthang, the walled city at the heart of Upper Mustang.
This Mustang trekking itinerary is ideal for travelers looking to experience high-
altitude trekking in Nepal, witness the breathtaking Himalayan views, and
immerse themselves in the rich Tibetan-in fl uenced culture. The trek covers
moderate distances each day, with manageable altitudes, making it suitable for
both novice and experienced trekkers.
Experience the charm of Mustang’s remote trails, traditional homestays, and
vibrant local festivals. Our Upper Mustang trek package includes guided tours,

accommodations, and meals, ensuring a hassle-free adventure. Whether you are
a solo traveler, couple, or small group, this short trek provides a once-in-a-lifetime
Himalayan experience without the need for a long expedition.

data.name: Kathmandu
data.description: Kathmandu, the capital city of Nepal, is nestled in the Kathmandu Valley. It's known for its rich cultural heritage, with numerous temples and historical sites, including the Kathmandu Durbar Square, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. The city o ff ers stunning views of the Himalayas and the valley. There are plenty of adventure activities like trekking, mountain biking, and paragliding. The locals are known for their friendliness and hospitality. However, the city faces challenges like air pollution, tra ffi c congestion, and lack of basic infrastructure.

data.name: Pokhara
data.description: Pokhara is a city in central Nepal, known for its stunning natural beauty and adventure sports. It's a gateway to the Annapurna Circuit, a popular trail in the Himalayas, and o ff ers activities like paragliding, white-water rafting, and boating on Phewa Lake. Cultural sites include the World Peace Pagoda and several Tibetan refugee settlements. The city is also known for its warm hospitality and delicious local cuisine.

data.name: Phewa Lake
data.description: Phewa Lake, situated in Pokhara, is the second largest lake in Nepal and a major tourist destination. This picturesque lake is surrounded by lush hills and o ff ers breathtaking views of the Annapurna mountain range. Visitors can enjoy activities such as boating, kayaking, and fi shing, making it a perfect spot for relaxation and adventure. The lake is also home to the Tal Barahi Temple, which is located on an island in the center of the water. With its serene atmosphere, Phewa Lake attracts nature lovers and photographers alike.

data.title: Pokhara to Jomsom, Trek to Kagbeni

data.name: Jomsom
data.description: Jomsom is a town located in the Dhaulagiri Zone of Nepal. It serves as the administrative center of the Mustang District and is situated at an altitude of approximately 2,700 meters (8,860 feet) in the Kali Gandaki Valley. Jomsom is a popular starting point for treks to the Annapurna and Mustang regions, o ff ering stunning views of the surrounding Himalayan peaks. The town is accessible by a small airport, which connects it to Pokhara, and is known for its unique landscape, cultural heritage, and as a gateway to the ancient kingdom of Lo Manthang.

data.name: Kali Gandaki River
data.description: Kali Gandaki River, Nepal The Kali Gandaki River is a major waterway in Nepal, originating near the Tibetan border in the Mustang region. It fl ows southward through the Kali Gandaki Gorge, one of the deepest gorges in the world, situated between the Dhaulagiri and Annapurna mountain ranges. The river holds profound religious signi fi cance in Hinduism, with its waters considered sacred and associated with the goddess Kali. Pilgrims often collect Shaligram fossils from its bed, revered as representations of Lord Vishnu. The Kali Gandaki also plays a crucial role in Nepal's economy, supporting agriculture along its banks and contributing to hydroelectric power generation through projects like the Kaligandaki A Hydroelectric Power Station. Additionally, the river is a popular destination for adventure tourism, o ff ering opportunities for trekking, white- water rafting, and exploration of its diverse ecosystems.

data.name: Kagbeni
data.description: Kagbeni is a picturesque village in the Dhaulagiri Zone of Nepal, situated in the Mustang District. It serves as a gateway to the Upper Mustang region, which is known for its unique Tibetan culture and stunning landscapes. Kagbeni is located at the con fl uence of the Kali Gandaki River and the Jhong Khola, making it a signi fi cant stop for trekkers on the Annapurna Circuit. The village is characterized by its traditional mud-brick houses, ancient monasteries, and narrow alleyways. Kagbeni's strategic location and cultural signi fi cance make it a popular destination for tourists seeking to explore the rich heritage and natural beauty of the Mustang region.

data.name: Charang
data.description: Charang is a picturesque village located in the Lo Manthang Municipality of Nepal, situated in the Mustang district. Known for its stunning landscapes, it o ff ers a glimpse into the traditional Tibetan culture, with its ancient monasteries and unique architecture. The village is characterized by its adobe houses and o ff ers views of the surrounding mountains and valleys. Charang serves as a gateway for trekkers exploring the high-altitude terrain of the Mustang region, making it a serene spot for travelers seeking adventure and tranquility.

data.name: Lo Manthang Village
data.description: Lo Manthang Village is an ancient settlement located in the Mustang district of Nepal, renowned for its well-preserved medieval architecture and vibrant cultural heritage. Established in the 15th century, the village serves as the capital of the Kingdom of Lo and is known for its stunning monasteries, traditional mud-brick houses, and surrounding dramatic landscapes. The area is characterized by its high- altitude environment and has become a focal point for trekkers and cultural explorers, drawing visitors interested in the unique practices of its Tibetan Buddhist communities.

data.name: Damodar Kunda
data.description: Damodar Kunda is a revered high-altitude lake sitting at an elevation of approximately 4,700 meters in the Annapurna region of Nepal. It holds immense signi fi cance for Hindu believers, often associated with Lord Krishna and visited by pilgrims seeking spiritual merit. The lake is characterized by stunning natural beauty, surrounded by majestic Himalayan peaks and o ff ering breathtaking views. The journey to reach Damodar Kunda is an adventure in itself, requiring a trek through picturesque landscapes fi lled with diverse fl ora and fauna, making it a memorable destination for travelers and spiritual seekers.

data.name: Ghiling
data.description: Ghiling is a picturesque village located in the Dhami region of Nepal. Situated along the Annapurna Circuit, it serves as a scenic stop for trekkers exploring the Himalayas. The village is characterized by its traditional stone houses and vibrant farming fi elds, set against a backdrop of stunning mountain vistas. Visitors can immerse themselves in the local culture, enjoying the tranquil atmosphere and the warm hospitality of the residents. Ghiling provides a unique perspective on rural life in Nepal, making it a worthwhile destination for adventurers and nature enthusiasts.

data.name: Chhusang
data.description: Chhusang, Nepal Chhusang is a serene village located in the Mustang region of Nepal, often frequented by trekkers exploring the Annapurna Circuit. It o ff ers stunning views of the surrounding mountains and valleys. The village is known for its unique landscape, featuring a mix of arid terrain and lush greenery. Traditional Tibetan culture is prevalent, with local architecture re fl ecting this heritage. Chhusang serves as a peaceful waypoint for travelers seeking to experience the natural beauty and cultural richness of the region.
